description: This file defines the Coocook::Model::Messages class, which manages a collection of message hashes with different types (debug, info, warn, error). It provides methods to add messages, clear the message list, retrieve all messages, and get the next message. It also dynamically creates methods for each message type.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::Messages
classes.description: A class for managing a list of messages with different severity types, supporting addition, retrieval, and clearing of messages.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that initializes and returns a new instance of the Messages class.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a message to the collection. Accepts a hash reference, a string, or a hash with 'type' and 'text'/'html'. Validates message type and required fields.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all messages from the collection.

methods.name: messages
methods.description: Returns an array reference containing all messages.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next message in the collection, removing it from the list.
